--- braced_subqueries_hints_and_path_modes.sql
GRAPH FinGraph
RETURN
  EXISTS @{a=1} { ANY SHORTEST (a)-[]->(b) } AS any_shortest,
  EXISTS { TRAIL PATH (a)-[]->(b) } AS trail_path,
  VALUE @{a=1} { RETURN 1 AS value } AS hinted_value

--- SQL
GRAPH FinGraph RETURN EXISTS @{a=1} { ANY SHORTEST (a)-[]->(b) } AS any_shortest, EXISTS { TRAIL PATH (a)-[]->(b) } AS trail_path, VALUE @{a=1} { RETURN 1 AS value } AS hinted_value
